{{Otheruses|Solar flare}}
[[File:Stellarflare.png|thumb|250px|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] depicts a week-long solar flare forecast.]]
{{Quote|Pronounced stellar flare activity this week; UV Index peaking at 44.9; recommend EM shielding on all electronics.|HoloNet News Weather Report|<ref name="holonet">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|weather.html|Weather Report}}</ref>}}
A '''solar flare''', '''stellar flare''', or '''coronal flare'''<ref name="SS">{{JournalCite|12|Shape-shifters}}</ref> was a sudden brightening over the surface of a [[Star/Legends|star]] or the solar limb, which released a large amount of energy.

The [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] network typically advised [[Electromagnetic field/Legends|electromagnetic]] shielding on all electronic devices when the [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] index peaked at around 44.9.<ref name="holonet" />

[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] observed something that looked like a miniature solar flare when the ''[[FlakBlaster Ten]]''{{'s}} defense shields went down.

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
When solar flares hit a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface, it excited [[mind eel]]s, and weather forecasts recommended the watching of mind eels and their offspring during this time. These creatures did not threaten nearby farmers, as they complied with the crop boundaries set in [[The Relevant Farm Act of Thairwsthis 12]].<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>

Solar flares were also mentioned in the piece of work ''[[Affirmation for Amber Day Six: My Love Flows Ambiently and Infinitely]]''.<ref name="MAGL" />
{{Noncanonend}}
